environment.description: EC2 instance (i-0b7c9d3e2f) in VPC vpc-0x4e7b, private subnet (no IGW/NAT route to 0.0.0.0/0 in rtb-0a2f8c). Exposed exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f8a3b2c1d9e7f6a (Interface VPC Endpoint Service). Consumers connect via vpce-04d8e9f1a2b3c5d6 in their own VPCs. The endpoint service has `acceptance_required: true` and allowed principals restricted to arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root. DNS is private hosted zone only (no public resolution). Security group sg-0ab3c7 on the ENI allows inbound TCP/8080 only from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. Session cookies use default SameSite=Lax (Flask default when SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE not overridden). NACLs on subnet deny all traffic from non-RFC1918 sources.

config.subnet_type: private (no IGW, no NAT in route table rtb-0a2f8c)
config.dns_resolution: private hosted zone only, no public records
